}}'''Sora Grady''' is the wife of [[Asha'man]] [[Jur Grady]], with whom she has a son, named [[Gadren Grady]].

== Appearance ==
She is plump and pale haired.

== Activities ==
She appears to resent [[Rand al'Thor]] for convincing Grady to stay at the [[Black Tower]] instead of returning home.{{ref/book|6|3}}{{ref/book|6|11}} When Rand later visits [[Mazrim Taim]], she serves him wine at the farmhouse.{{ref/book|6|42}} Jur bonds himself to Sora to act like a [[Warder]] for her and maintain a link when they are apart.{{ref/book|7|27}}
